source: https://tdac.immigration.go.th/arrival-card/ (live form field rules, version 2026.09.00) and the official user guide, read 2026-10-15

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Printed on the photo page of your passport. Letters and digits only, up to 20, no spaces.

errors.tooShort: Check the number on your passport photo page
errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 20 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols
errors.invalidFormat: Letters and numbers only, up to 20 — no spaces or dashes

given_name.label: First name
given_name.help: Given names exactly as shown on your passport. Letters A–Z and spaces only. A middle name may go in the separate Middle Name box.

errors.tooLong: Max 60 characters. Use the Latin abbreviation shown on your passport.
errors.invalidChars: Letters A–Z and spaces only — no accents, hyphens or other characters

middle_name.label: Middle name
middle_name.help: Optional. Letters A–Z and spaces only. Leave it empty if you keep every given name in First Name.

errors.invalidChars: Letters A–Z and spaces only — no accents, dots or other characters

family_name.label: Family name
family_name.help: Exactly as shown on your passport. The TDAC takes letters A–Z and spaces only: type a space for a hyphen. No family name? Type a single -.

errors.required: Family name is required — type - if your passport has none
errors.invalidChars: Letters A–Z and spaces only (a hyphen becomes a space), or a single - if you have no family name

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Check it here as YYYY-MM-DD. On the TDAC it goes in three boxes: year, month, day.

errors.tooEarly: Date of birth seems too far in the past — double check
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be in the future

flight_number.label: Flight No./Vehicle No.
flight_number.help: Up to 20 characters: letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation, not starting with - + = or @. By land, the vehicle number.

errors.invalidFormat: Letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation only; it cannot start with - + = or @

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: yyyy/mm/dd, as the TDAC date box shows it. The TDAC accepts today through 3 days ahead.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: The TDAC only takes an arrival date up to 3 days ahead. Come back closer to the date.

email.label: Email
email.help: Asked once, after the preview, for the whole submission. Max 50 characters. Use an email you can check on your phone.

errors.invalidFormat: Not accepted by the TDAC: check for spaces, a missing dot in the domain, or a typo

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Digits only, up to 25. On the official form the country code goes in a separate Code box.

errors.required: Phone number is required on the current TDAC
errors.invalidFormat: Digits only, up to 25 — no + or spaces. Put the country code in the separate Code box.
